intro: Onyxia is the broodmother of the black dragonflight and the devious daughter of Deathwing. Lurking in her wyrm lair within Dustwallow Marsh, she tends to her burgeoning brood while coordinating with her sinister dragonflight to exert dominance over the mortal realms.
